definition.simple: The process of breaking down food into tiny pieces so your body can use it for energy.
definition.academic: The breakdown of complex, large, insoluble food molecules into smaller, soluble molecules that can be absorbed into the blood.

common_misconceptions: Digestion only happens in the stomach.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student what happens if you put sugar in water versus a solid rock. Digestion turns food into something that can dissolve!
